name: fix-local-boundary-misc
title: P2:本地边界与sidecar杂项加固
description: 五项小型边界修复合并(check-localfs/check-pdfium/check-eng CONFIRMED,sidecar为PARTIAL)。(1)附件下载:read.rs resolve_download_path(221-233)不可信attachment.filename直接join输出目录且fs::copy(152-155)默认覆盖;改file_name() sanitize+拒绝separator/absolute+默认create_new显式--force才覆盖。(2)annotation数值:annotation.rs:134-166与pdf.rs build_area_position(424-474)对x/y/width/height无finite/range校验,NaN/inf/负数直通payload;加finite+0<=x,y<1+width,height>0校验。(3)graph viewer:app.js esc()仅转义4字符,node.url进href无scheme白名单,target=_blank无noopener;server.rs asset()(87-93)无CSP/nosniff;改DOM API+http/https白名单+rel=noopener+CSP default-src self。(4)sidecar统一:PdfCache::new(pdf.rs:482-506)无WAL/busy_timeout且.md_cache.sqlite为全workspace共享(workspace_rag.rs:31);cache key为path+mtime+len的MD5(859-872);统一WAL+busy_timeout+schema version+更强fingerprint。(5)connector TOCTOU:import.rs:31-67预览与--confirm两次独立进程调用间UI selection可变;confirm前重新获取target比较fingerprint,变化则abort。
